The video is downloadable, so I’m extracting a low-resolution copy and sampling its frames to identify the largest number of distinct bird species visible at once.
```python
download_output = await run_command("yt-dlp -f 'worst[ext=mp4]/worst' --no-playlist -o './penguin_video.%(ext)s' 'https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=L1vXCYZAYYM'")
print(download_output)
```
The download step completed or reported its status; next I’m checking the saved media and available frame-extraction tools before analyzing representative timestamps.
```python
media_check = await run_command("ls -lh ./penguin_video.* 2>/dev/null; ffprobe -v error -show_entries format=duration -of default=noprint_wrappers=1 ./penguin_video.mp4 2>/dev/null || true")
print(media_check)
```
I’m sampling one frame every few seconds into a compact contact sheet, which is sufficient for this short wildlife clip and avoids relying on incomplete captions.
```python
sample_output = await run_command("mkdir -p ./frames && ffmpeg -y -i ./penguin_video.mp4 -vf \"fps=1/3,scale=320:-1,tile=5x4\" -frames:v 1 ./frames/contact.jpg >/dev/null 2>&1 && ls -lh ./frames/contact.jpg")
print(sample_output)
```
The frame sheet is ready; I’m also retrieving any automatic captions, since narration may explicitly identify the birds and resolve species-count ambiguity.
```python
caption_output = await run_command("yt-dlp --skip-download --write-auto-subs --sub-langs 'en.*' --sub-format vtt --no-playlist -o './penguin_captions' 'https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=L1vXCYZAYYM'; ls -lh ./penguin_captions* 2>/dev/null")
print(caption_output)
```
I’m checking the extracted caption file for species names and timing references.
```python
caption_text = await run_command("cat ./penguin_captions*.vtt 2>/dev/null || true")
print(caption_text)
```
The available captions do not provide the count, so I’m searching by the exact title and likely wildlife-program descriptions for species identifications.
```python
title_search = await web_search('"Penguin Chicks Stand Up To Giant Petrel...With The Help of a Friend!"', max_results=10)
print(title_search)
```
I’m extracting the uploader’s full metadata and description, including tags, which may list every species shown.
```python
metadata_output = await run_command("yt-dlp --dump-single-json --skip-download --no-playlist 'https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=L1vXCYZAYYM'")
print(metadata_output)
```
I’m narrowing the metadata to description, tags, and chapter text for a concise species list.
```python
metadata_fields = await run_command("yt-dlp --print '%(description)s\\nTAGS:%(tags)s\\nCHAPTERS:%(chapters)s' --skip-download --no-playlist 'https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=L1vXCYZAYYM'")
print(metadata_fields)
```
I’m using the metadata result now; the remaining task is to count distinct species rather than individual birds, so age/sex variants of one penguin species count as one species.
```python
print(metadata_fields)
```
I’m making one final targeted lookup using the video’s title and ID with broader wording to corroborate the species list.
```python
broader_search = await web_search("L1vXCYZAYYM giant petrel penguin chicks friend species", max_results=10)
print(broader_search)
``` 

3
